rex.why: Required inside Rex: every pane, state and process comes from the running Rex server, read through its CLI.

herdr.why: Required inside Herdr: the pane and agent inventory comes from the running Herdr session through its CLI.

luvus.why: Required inside Luvus: every figure comes from the running Luvus session's own UHP answers, reached through its CLI.

ps.why: Reads the local process table: the work an agent left running, shown under it on every board, and inside Luvus the process names and commands for the Opscope filter. Without it, each agent says its background work could not be read, and Luvus matches only its reported command labels.
